content.name: Ryan Kowalski
content.title: Account Executive, SMB
content.summary: SMB account executive promoted from SDR after 20 months, selling HR and payroll software to businesses with 20 to 200 employees. Closed $612,000 in new annual recurring revenue in my first full year as an AE, finishing at 109% of quota.

experience.title: Account Executive, SMB
bullets: Closed $612,000 in new ARR over four quarters against a $560,000 quota, with an average deal size of $14,800.
Run 12 to 15 discovery and demo calls a week with owners and office managers, keeping a 30-day average sales cycle.
Built a payroll-switching checklist with the implementation team that lowered first-90-day churn among my customers to under 4%.
Partner with two SDRs on outbound sequences for Midwest restaurant groups, a segment that now makes up a quarter of my pipeline.

experience.title: Sales Development Representative
bullets: Booked 312 qualified meetings for three account executives through cold calls, email and LinkedIn, averaging 118% of monthly target.
Researched freight brokers and 3PLs in ZoomInfo and wrote personalized openers that doubled my reply rate to 8%.
Sourced opportunities that later closed for $1.04M in first-year contract value.
Wrote objection-handling notes that became part of onboarding for the next SDR class.

education.details: GPA 3.5/4.0. Worked 20 hours a week in campus recreation while studying.

achievements.title: President's Club (SDR)
achievements.detail: Top SDR by sourced pipeline in 2024.

achievements.title: Fast promotion
achievements.detail: Moved from SDR to AE in 20 months, ahead of the usual 24-month path.
